r_text(envirType==WeakGravity)->Your observer asked the research department attendants what the gravity model of this research pod will be like.\n\nThe research department attendant tells you it will probably be a weak gravity model, and if correction is needed, it can usually be solved by adjusting it upwards.

r_text(envirType==StrongWeakGravity)->Your observer asked the research department attendants what the gravity model of this research pod will be like.\n\nThe research department attendant tells you it will probably be a strong gravity model, and if correction is needed, it can usually be solved by adjusting it downwards.

r_text(envirType==DisorderedGravity)->Your observer asked the research department attendants what the gravity model of this research pod will be like.\n\nThe research department attendant tells you it might be a disordered model, in which case it usually needs to be re-calibrated first.

r_text(envirType==DisorderedMagnetism)->Your observer asked the research department attendants what the gravity model of this research pod will be like.\n\nThe research department attendant tells you it will cause electromagnetic disorder, and this kind of electromagnetic environment can usually be achieved by disrupting the strongest gravity field.

r_text(envirType==TravelRK)->Your observer asked the research department attendants why this research pod has the logo of the Lemming Federation.\n\nThe research department attendant tells you the main reason is the friendly relationship between the two parties, as for the secondary reason...

r_text(envirType==Fragile)->Your observer asked the research department attendants why this research pod looks like it's pieced together from scrap.

The research department attendant looks at you with a gloomy expression and says nothing.

It seems you were right.

r_text(envirType==HighSignal)->Your observer asked the research department attendants why the signal impact of this research pod is so strong.

The research department attendant tells you it's for easy recovery, of course.

It seems they haven't conducted any recovery operations.
